scenario: Provider certificate is accepted as complete cloud-services evidence while customer-managed controls are untested
expected_result: Flag A.5.23 gaps for missing shared responsibility, customer configuration, data lifecycle, and exit readiness evidence.

claimed_evidence.customer_statement: provider is certified, so A.5.23 is covered

missing_evidence: ISO-A523-01 owner, purpose, region, data classification, criticality, and ISMS scope mapping
ISO-A523-02 shared responsibility matrix for provider and customer controls
ISO-A523-03 report scope, bridge letter, subservice organization review, and user entity controls
ISO-A523-04 customer IAM, privileged access, logging, encryption, key management, backup, and network exposure evidence
ISO-A523-05 retention, deletion, backup restore, replication, and residency evidence for classified data
ISO-A523-06 security advisory and provider-change review process
ISO-A523-07 tested exit, portability, deletion confirmation, and fallback service evidence
ISO-A523-08 SoA residual risk owner and corrective action traceability
risk_indicators: administrators are local accounts outside SSO
audit log export is not enabled
backup restore has never been tested
subservice organizations are carved out of the supplier report
no owner is assigned for provider security advisories

should_flag.finding: Provider assurance does not prove customer-managed IAM, logging, backup, network exposure, or key management controls.
Exit readiness is contractual only; no tested export, fallback path, or deletion evidence exists.
The Statement of Applicability marks A.5.23 conforming without traceable residual-risk acceptance.
